plan.title: Extract surface candidates and compare against read-only baselines

criteria.description: Surface execution validates prerequisites and before/after inputs, and failed extraction cannot preserve ready candidate authority.
Diff deterministically reports missing baseline, additions, changes and removals while rejecting stale or failed candidates.
Baseline extract/diff CLI returns distinct success, changes and errors without writing approved baselines.
Persisted snapshots reject tampering, ambiguous JSON and identity mismatches.

limitations: Baseline files are read-only in this task; approval is NARU-010.
Execution is trusted shell code, not a process sandbox; leftover running state requires manual recovery.
No surface gate integration or automatic baseline acceptance. Windows process-tree runtime remains unverified.
